description: Header file defining prototypes, constants, and types for miscellaneous firmware functions for STM32F10x microcontrollers, including NVIC configuration and system low power modes.

methods.name: NVIC_PriorityGroupConfig
methods.description: Configures the priority grouping for the Nested Vectored Interrupt Controller (NVIC).

methods.name: NVIC_Init
methods.description: Initializes NVIC with specified interrupt channel and priority settings.

methods.name: NVIC_SetVectorTable
methods.description: Sets the base address of the vector table.

methods.name: SysTick_CLKSourceConfig
methods.description: Configures the clock source for the SysTick timer.
